# make test-go-mutants, in make ci): each line "<mutant> | <file> | <exact

# RevokedIssuerRefused), spec/proverif/e2ee_tcp.pv (the client's name and
# check, the group). Not here: the issuer's (org/orgpki), keep-old-root
# (the verifier holds one root: TakeRotation replaces it).
